purpose: Separate boundary-critical review work from metadata-only diagnostics without approving content, boundaries, mappings, or cutover.

missing-start-locator.description: A segment start cannot be evaluated without locator evidence.

split-required-by-reconstruction-plan.description: The legacy-to-canonical reconstruction requires an explicit split decision.

manual-reconstruction-review.description: The reconstruction plan already requires editorial judgment.

same-page-successor-boundary.description: Adjacent proposals begin on the same page and need finer boundary evidence.

container-intro-boundary.description: A structural container may have a separate introduction that must be confirmed.

legacy-word-count-oversized.description: The legacy estimate indicates a potentially oversized Reader unit.

no-legacy-word-count-estimate.description: Missing legacy size metadata does not itself make a canonical boundary invalid.

manual-boundary-review.description: Retain in the active boundary-review queue.

manual-structural-review.description: Retain and prioritize because a structural reconstruction decision is required.

defer-metadata-only.description: Remove from the active boundary-review workload while preserving the missing estimate as deferred metadata.
